mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over the past 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the probability of central bank rate cuts and triggers a flight to equity risk assets, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in residential construction starts below 570,000 units over the past 2 months signals weakening household demand and a contraction in the housing sector, which triggers a policy response from the Federal Reserve and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 570.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 95.0 over the past 2 months signals weakening real economic activity, which increases the likelihood of monetary policy accommodation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 95.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the probability of aggressive monetary easing and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS fall below thresholds, or the interaction Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.2% over the past 3 months, combined with a stable or declining federal funds rate, signals that inflation is outpacing monetary policy tightening, increasing the risk of stagflation and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.2 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.2, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a labor market contraction, which increases the likelihood of a dovish Fed response and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS and UNRATE meet thresholds, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures below 350,000 million dollars, combined with a contraction in industrial production, signals a broad-based demand slowdown that triggers a policy response and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and INDPRO fall below thresholds, or the interaction Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
